specification:
Type: microsim **sim-id:** alignment-readability-scorer
**Library:** p5.js
**Status:** Specified
**Bloom Level:** Apply
**Bloom Verb:** apply
**Learning Objective:** The learner will apply the ten alignment checks and the ten readability checks, with the Chapter 3 scoring rules, to choose the metric score for each of six cases, with at least 5 of 6 scores exactly correct on the first attempt. **Prerequisites:** The Alignment Metric, The Readability Metric, Scoring Alignment, Scoring Readability, Metric Score, Scoring Descriptor (all defined in this chapter or in Chapter 3 above this block). **Evidence of Mastery:** For each case the learner chooses a whole-number score from 0 to 10 after seeing the ten check results. A score is correct when it equals the Correct score column in Content. Mastery is at least 5 of 6 scores correct on the first attempt. Opening the check lists and the descriptor table is exploration, not evidence. **Misconceptions:** (1) Every failed check lowers the score equally. (2) A serious failure always drops a full band. (3) The two metrics use different scoring rules. **Instructional Rationale:** Applying a scoring procedure to new cases is an Apply-level task. Three cases for each metric, with different counts and different serious failures, make the learner repeat the same procedure on two sets of checks. **Content:** The two ten-check lists are those in the chapter sections "Scoring Alignment" and "Scoring Readability", each marked serious or not. The descriptor bands applied to the share of checks passed: 0% is 0; 1% to 24% is 1 to 2; 25% to 49% is 3 to 4; 50% to 74% is 5 to 6; 75% to 89% is 7 to 8; 90% to 100% is 9 to 10. Within a two-number band, choose the lower number when a serious check failed and the higher number otherwise. A score of 10 requires every check to pass. A check that does not apply counts as passed. The six cases: | # | Metric | Resource | Checks failed | Checks passed | Share | Band | Serious failure? | Correct score | Why (shown as feedback) | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | Alignment | Open Algebra Unit | None | 10 | 100% | 9 to 10 | No | 10 | Every check passed. | | 2 | Alignment | Watershed Basics | 3, 4, 6, 8 | 6 | 60% | 5 to 6 | No | 6 | None of the failures is serious, so the higher number applies. | | 3 | Alignment | Unit Without Outcomes | 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8 | 3 (checks 7, 9, 10) | 30% | 3 to 4 | Yes, checks 1 and 2 | 3 | The unit states no outcomes, which is serious, so the lower number applies. | | 4 | Readability | Open Algebra Unit | None | 10 | 100% | 9 to 10 | No | 10 | Every check passed. | | 5 | Readability | Watershed Basics | 4 and 5 | 8 | 80% | 7 to 8 | No | 8 | Neither failure is serious, so the higher number applies. | | 6 | Readability | College Text Used in Grade 7 | 2, 4, 5, 6, 7 | 5 (checks 1, 3, 8, 9, 10) | 50% | 5 to 6 | Yes, check 2 | 5 | The reading level is far above the audience, which is serious, so the lower number applies. | **Provenance:** The ten checks and the bands follow the chapter sections "Scoring Alignment" and "Scoring Readability" and Chapter 3. The six cases are illustrative cases written for this chapter, and the sim labels them "illustrative examples". Cases 2 and 5 are the chapter's worked examples. **Rules:** A score is the band chosen from the share passed, then the number chosen within the band by the serious-failure rule. Each case has exactly one correct score. For a band that holds a single number, that number is the score. **Learner Activity:** 1. The sim shows case 1 with its ten check results and the name of the metric. 2. The learner may open the check list and the descriptor table. 3. The learner chooses a score from 0 to 10, and the choice is committed. 4. The sim shows the count of passes, the band, whether a serious check failed, and the correct score with the Why text. 5. After case 6 the sim shows the summary. **Feedback:** 6 cases in the fixed order, one attempt each. Correct: "Correct: [score]. [Why]". Incorrect: "Not quite. [passes] checks passed, which is [share] and the [band] band. [Why]". The summary shows "[n] of 6 correct on the first attempt". At 5 or more it adds "You can score both metrics." Below 5 it lists the Why text of each missed case. **Starting State:** Case 1 with all ten results shown and no score chosen. The question shown is "What alignment score does this resource earn?" **Chapter Anchors:** The chapter's worked examples score Watershed Basics 6 on alignment, with failures of checks 3, 4, 6, and 8, and 8 on readability, with failures of checks 4 and 5. The chapter says a serious failure puts the score at the lower number in the band.
